title: Speeding Traffic Stop Turns Up 2,000 Grams of Marijuana
description:
Speeding Traffic Stop Turns Up 2,000 Grams of Marijuana 

In La Crosse County, this routine traffic stop of a speeding vehicle reveals more than expected. A 38-year-old man was charged after police allegedly found nearly 2,000 grams of marijuana.
